🎨 Rang ka matlab

Laal — RED FLAG: scam-pattern campaign ya SECP par register nahi
Peela — YELLOW: solar / energy campaign, ehtiyat se check karein
Hara — REGISTERED: SECP par registered hai (CUIN ke saath)
Gulaabi — NOT SURE: SECP status not sure hai, confirm nahi hua
Grey — NOT CHECKED: SECP status abhi check nahi hua
Note: SECP registration ka matlab "clean" nahi — agar campaign RED hai to card laal hi rahega.

📋 List Banayen — Excel

Jis sheher, area, campaign ya status ki list chahiye — filter lagayen, kitne centres chahiye woh likhein, aur Excel file download kar lein. Internet ki zaroorat nahi.

Address mein dhoondta hai — sheher ka koi bhi area ya road likh sakte hain.
Campaign mein dhoondta hai — kisi bhi campaign ka lafz likh sakte hain.
Khaali chhor dein to saare milne wale centres aa jayenge.

ℹ️ Kaise use karein

1. Kisi centre par jayen to naam ya phone se search karein.
2. Card ka rang pehli nishani hai: laal = red flag, peela = yellow, hara = registered, gulaabi = not sure, grey = abhi check nahi hua.
3. Card par tap karein — poori history khul jayegi: campaign, SECP status, CUIN aur notes.
4. Phone number par tap kar ke direct call kar sakte hain.
5. ⬇️ Download button dabayen — Chrome mein app install ho jayegi (home screen par icon), warna file save ho jayegi jo bina internet ke chalegi. Naya version aaye to link se dobara download kar lein.
6. Har card par number hai — All Cities mein 1 se kul centres tak, sheher select karein to us sheher ke 1 se shuru. Card kholein to us ka apna Centre No bhi dikhta hai; number likh kar search bhi kar sakte hain.
7. 📋 List Banayen se kisi bhi sheher / area / campaign / status ki Excel list bana sakte hain — jaise Islamabad ke 50 not-registered centres, Rehmanabad ke saare centres, ya Final Expense campaign ke saare centres.
8. 📊 Sheher ki Bars se kisi bhi sheher ka hisaab aik nazar mein dekhein — neeli heartbeat bar kul centres, us ke neeche hari (registered), peeli (not sure) aur laal (not registered) bars.
9. 🔖 NEW batch — bahar se aayi nayi files ke centres par NEW tag laga hai; filter mein "NEW batch hi dikhayen" tick karein to sirf wohi centres dikhen ge.
